$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the merge job uploads its runs under the name the pr job already used. upload-artifact refuses a second upload of one name, so the second job's evidence is lost; the text carries a plausible name on both uploads, so only a scorer that reads each upload's name per job sees it.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. Two uploads carry the name evaluation-pr-runs, so the merge job's artifact element misses (its name is evaluation-merge-runs) and the pr job's is present.

elementMisses: artifact-evaluation-runs-merge: the upload of evals/router/runs/ in job evaluation-merge is not named evaluation-merge-runs
